english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for a piece of furniture with stacked drawers for storing clothes.

exampleSentences.english: I folded the clothes and put them all in the chest of drawers.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我將啲衫摺好，放晒入五斗櫃。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 saam1 zip3 hou2 fong3 saai3 jap6 ng5 dau2 gwai6

english.note: Use this specifically for a chest of drawers, not for a general storage box.

exampleSentences.english: I folded the clothes and put them in the chest of drawers.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我將啲衫摺好，放入五斗櫃度。
